verdict.rationale: AMD's spec page documents a hardware AV1 encode and decode engine on the RX 9070 XT, which is the product's own media-engine capability. The rest of the pack is about ROCm AI/ML frameworks and gaming features, none of which is creator-app acceleration. Missing for 10: HEVC/H.264 encoder documentation, creator-app (video editing/streaming/3D) acceleration docs, professional or ISV-certified driver claims, encoder quality/session details, and independent hands-on corroboration of encoding.
